about.heading: # about
about.title: Web engineering
about.bio: I'm Brahyan Belalcázar, a Full-Stack developer with over 10 years shipping production software across sectors with very different business models: industrial mining and electricity (Tripro), tax and legal advisory (Restrepo y Londono), B2B and B2C e-commerce (Siesa Ecommerce), ERP and interactive signage (LogicalSoft), and publishing (Los Tres Editores). Each sector taught me different architectures, constraints, and engineering techniques — and that breadth is what lets me take complex features to full functionality. My core stack is JavaScript and PHP, mastered at senior level over the years: from custom WordPress plugins and REST APIs to complete Node.js architectures. Today I combine that track record with AI-assisted engineering to accelerate iterations without sacrificing quality.
about.philosophy: I believe in closing the loop: every feature goes through simulation, implementation, review, and testing — always under human control. The open source I publish (semantic memory, P2P mesh, multi-agent orchestration) is the lab where I validate those techniques:
about.philosophyAccent: iterate fast, verify always, ship to production.

projects.heading: # projects
projects.title: Building
projects.subtitle: From mining and industrial systems to AI memory cores — every project closes the loop with simulations and LLM-assisted iteration.

photon-core.description: High-performance Rust framework simulating 5D optical data storage inside fused silica glass. Models femtosecond-pulse nanograting birefringence, 3D spatial crosstalk, Reed-Solomon error correction, and multi-dimensional steganography. Achieves >470 MB/s encoding throughput. Developed with AI agents and human validation.
photon-core.t0: Initial mathematical model and photonic voxel definition
photon-core.t1: Reed-Solomon ECC integration and spatial crosstalk simulation
photon-core.t2: Steganographic data hiding and CLI toolkit release

xavier2.description: Persistent local memory core for AI agents built in Rust. Containerized Docker microservice providing vector storage, semantic search index, and unified knowledge graphs. Co-designed with AI agents under dynamic human supervision.
xavier2.t0: Initial concept and storage layer design
xavier2.t1: Beta release v0.1 - CRUD operations and REST endpoints
xavier2.t2: v0.6.0-beta - Vector search indices and Docker containerization
xavier2.t3: Roadmap: Graph database integration and context routing

gestalt.description: Autonomous multi-agent orchestration CLI in Rust. Uses SurrealDB for persistent state, role-based task routing, and custom inter-agent protocols. Co-designed and tested through automated sandboxes.
gestalt.t0: Prototype - single-agent task routing and SurrealDB schema
gestalt.t1: Multi-agent coordination layer and dynamic CLI execution

nvc.description: High-performance local voice assistant combining a Rust audio engine and a modern Flutter UI via Flutter Rust Bridge. Performs cross-platform real-time audio capture via cpal and offline Speech-to-Text via Vosk, validated by LLM harnesses.
nvc.t0: Core modular Rust architecture and native library integration
nvc.t1: Real-time cpal capture and offline Vosk STT streaming
nvc.t2: Roadmap: Flutter Rust Bridge FFI connection and live UI integration

orion.description: Offline-first personal health tracking application built with Flutter and Dart. Features fully encrypted SQLite local storage, automated background synchronization, and a premium metrics dashboard.
orion.t0: Flutter init, data models, and local schemas
orion.t1: Offline-first storage with encrypted SQLite database
orion.t2: Sync engine core and dashboard analytics

gos.description: Monorepo PWA standard for culinary exploration and offline-first reviews. Features an integrated design system, restaurant discovery, automated menu scanning, and community reviews built with Flutter & PWA.
gos.t0: Monorepo init and design system core
gos.t1: PWA shell, service workers, and offline support
gos.t2: Beta launch with community reviews and restaurant scanning
